quadrature.method: Trapezoidal Volterra time integration; Gauss-Legendre unconditional subthreshold mark integration; scalar Brent root
quadrature.error_claim: Successive-grid difference is heuristic, not certified error

monte_carlo.cases: every20th test origin starting0, all9 targets;306 cases
monte_carlo.censoring: Return lower/upper success fractions accounting for every unfinished or unstarted planned replicate; never discard difficult realizations
monte_carlo.uncertainty: Fixed-N Hoeffding allowance with union bound over306 cases; partial-simulation intervals widened for unknown outcomes
monte_carlo.target_absorption: Stop a replicate after first target event; this preserves the event indicator exactly
